summary: @servicetitan/measure-sheet-data 2.6.2 ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13) at install time, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with string-array obfuscation (shuffled constant `n7gIxM` and rotator `WV8StW`) that hides its actual behavior from static review and is only resolvable when executed under Bun. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on every `npm install`. The published tarball also contains a legitimate-looking dist/index.js for the advertised glass-measurement library, and the ServiceTitan-scoped package name and repository URL do not correspond to a documented use of a second runtime or an obfuscated install-time script — the shape is consistent with a trojanized publish under the @servicetitan scope. Alternate-runtime execution is used to evade Node-oriented static scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
